fixed.explanation: filterCookies prefixes a dot to every cookie domain, so host-only cookies match subdomains, and it uses a plain string prefix for paths. pathMatches in cookieStore appends a slash to both sides, so /foo matches /foo/. I replaced both with RFC 6265 domain-match and path-match. filterCookies uses inline helpers to avoid a circular import.

query.intent: The cookie URL filtering helper (filterCookies) prepends a dot to every cookie domain and compares paths as plain string prefixes; it must implement RFC 6265 domain-match (host-only cookies match only exact host) and path-match (exact or slash boundary). Also the cookie-sending path check (domainMatches/pathMatches in the network cookie store) appends a slash to the request path before comparing, which makes /foo match /foo/.
query.symptom: Cookie listing for URLs returns host-only cookies for subdomains and prefix-path cookies (/api for /apiv2), and a cookie with path /foo/ is sent to /foo.

history.analysis: filterCookies prepends a dot to every domain and uses a plain prefix path check, so it needs to use RFC 6265 domain and path matching. domainMatches in cookieStore.ts is already correct. The pathMatches in cookieStore.ts, which appends a slash, is not visible yet, so I need to see it before editing.
